activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1945 as von Neumann's representative U.S. activity year. The Institute for Advanced Study's Electronic Computer Project began in 1945 under his leadership, marking his foundational work on stored-program electronic computing.

sources.title: Electronic Computer Project — Institute for Advanced Study
sources.citation_text: The Institute for Advanced Study records that its Electronic Computer Project began in late 1945 under John von Neumann and was intended as a general-purpose scientific computing project.
